items.exampleEn: I don't like pepper on my eggs.
items.exampleZh: 我不喜歡在蛋上加胡椒。
我們需要一個更大的平底鍋。

items.exampleEn: My mother bakes bread every weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽每個週末都烤麵包。

items.exampleEn: The chef at this hotel is from France.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店的主廚來自法國。

items.exampleEn: You need flour, eggs and milk to make a cake.
items.exampleZh: 做蛋糕需要麵粉、蛋和牛奶。

items.exampleEn: There is no fork on the table.
What would you like for dessert?

items.exampleZh: 義大利麵是我最喜歡的食物。

items.sentenceEn: This chef bakes the best cakes in town.
items.sentenceZh: 這位廚師烤的蛋糕是全鎮最好吃的。

items.audioEn: For dessert, we have ice cream or fruit.
items.audioZh: 甜點我們有冰淇淋或水果。

items.sentenceEn: Eat your pasta with a fork.
items.sentenceZh: 用叉子吃你的義大利麵。

items.sentenceEn: Mix the flour with two eggs.
items.sentenceZh: 把麵粉和兩顆蛋拌在一起。

items.stemEn: Put the eggs in a hot ____ and cook them for two minutes.
items.stemZh: 把蛋放進熱鍋裡煎兩分鐘。

items.stemEn: I like to ____ cookies for my friends.
items.stemZh: 我喜歡烤餅乾給朋友吃。

items.passageEn: Leo wants to be a chef. Every Sunday, he cooks dinner for his family. Last week, he made pasta with fresh vegetables. He cooked the vegetables in a pan with a little salt and pepper. For dessert, he baked an apple cake. His father finished everything on his plate and said, "This is better than a restaurant!"
items.passageZh: Leo 想當廚師。每個星期天，他都為家人煮晚餐。上週，他做了新鮮蔬菜義大利麵。他用平底鍋炒蔬菜，加了一點鹽和胡椒。甜點他烤了一個蘋果蛋糕。他爸爸把盤子裡的東西吃得精光，還說：「這比餐廳還好吃！」

questions.questionZh: Leo 上週做了什麼主菜？

items.promptZh: 可以給我一支叉子和一把刀嗎？
referenceEn: Can I have a fork and a knife, please?
Could you give me a fork and a knife?
rubricZh: 客氣的請求可寫例如 Can I have…?、Could you give me…?

items.instructionZh: 用 dessert 造一個句子，說說你最喜歡的甜點。
referenceEn: My favorite dessert is chocolate cake.
I always want ice cream for dessert.
rubricZh: dessert 表示「甜點」（例如 for dessert、my favorite dessert）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My favorite dessert is）
